Research      My domain is completely interdisciplinary but I am not limited to any specific research domain.
plan         A number of research areas, mostly interdisciplinary in nature and open problems, where Artificial
                         intelligent techniques such as evolutionary computation, soft computing, and machine learning are
                  demanding tools to deal with, can be convenient for me to do work smoothly. However, I would
                       prefer an open-minded approach to selecting research topics, considering the following:  (i) social
                      relevance of the problem; (ii) encouragement of students to develop and pursue their research inter-
                          ests; and (iii) the multidisciplinary and collaborative nature of research. Currently, I am working on
                    problems of geotechnical engineering, and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), where i am aplying
                AIv& ML, meta-heuristic algorithms, and other computational intelligent methods. The results are
                     very promising for the future endeavor to solve other problems of real world.
